name: SOVEREIGN NERVE: Esports Combat League
description: SOVEREIGN NERVE is a five-versus-five competitive neural reflex combat title in which players pilot augmented-human avatars through devastated urban environments using direct BCI reflex integration — response times below 40 milliseconds are competitive, below 20 are elite. The game's 'Chrome Bracket' division specifically caters to players with military-grade augmentation, creating a parallel competitive scene that mainstream leagues refused to sanction, forcing SOVEREIGN NERVE to maintain two separate ranking ladders that frequently collide at invitation tournaments. The Season 3 championship in 2212 drew 14 million simultaneous feed viewers, briefly making it Meridian 88's most-watched live event.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 player with natural reflex times that rival military-grade chrome is being quietly headhunted by parties who seem less interested in esports sponsorship than in whatever biological anomaly produces her numbers.

The SOVEREIGN NERVE game engine contains a hidden spectator mode that records full BCI state data from all players — someone has been selling this data to corponation intelligence divisions for two seasons.

A retired champion is coaching a Shelf youth team and discovers one of her players is the biological child of the developer who built the game's reflex engine — and who died under unclear circumstances before launch.
